quotes.randomization: randomized according to their medical file number to receive or not the TXA: patients in ‘TXA’ group were those having an even medical file number during the first 6 months and those having an odd medical file number during the last 6 months of the study.
quotes.deviations: This was a prospective randomized open-label trial... This finding [pulmonary embolism] can be attributed to the open-label randomisation, the assessment of this complication was probably influenced by the TXA use.
quotes.missingData: 180 patients meeting inclusion criteria... 96 patients in 'TXA' group... 84 patients in 'noTXA' group. (Flowchart indicates all analyzed)
quotes.measurement: the assessment of this complication was probably influenced by the TXA use... disability assessed by one investigator using the Glasgow Outcome Scale (GOS) at day-28
quotes.reporting: The primary study endpoints were the benefits of TXA in reducing the needing of surgery or transfusion and the mortality rate up to 28 days after trauma. The secondary endpoints... (No trial registration mentioned)
